mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( group_id, username, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{role}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, username, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, role, enabled, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
